# ⚡ Lightning Abilities

**Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1**  
Adds lightning magic: mana, "Molnikes" currency, skill tree, flight, dash, shield, and glowing lightning bolts on your skin.

> 🌐 **Note:** The mod interface supports only English and Russian languages.

---

## 🎮 Controls (all keys can be rebound)

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| **V** | Toggle lightning on skin (required for all abilities) |
| **B** | Skill tree |
| **N** | Strong abilities wheel |
| **Double jump** | Lightning flight |
| **G** | Lightning bolt shot |
| **R** | Electric dash |
| **H** | Thunder shield |
| **X** | Lightning sprint |

> 💡 **Press V first** – abilities don't work without active lightning.

---

## 🔰 Progression

- **Mana** regenerates over time (faster in rain and thunderstorms). Getting struck by lightning fully replenishes your mana.
- **Molnikes** – currency. Drops from mobs (especially charged creepers) and during thunderstorms. Spent in the skill tree (**B**).
- In creative mode, mana is infinite.

---

## ⚡ Abilities

| Ability | Type | Brief description |
|---------|------|-------------------|
| Lightning bolt shot | active | beam, 3 damage, consumes mana |
| Lightning flight I / II | active | flight (II – deals damage on contact) |
| Lightning sprint I / II | active | speed boost (II – deals damage on contact) |
| Electric dash | active | dash + damage, 10s cooldown |
| Thunder shield (3 lvls) | active | absorbs damage (5/10/15%) |
| Pain discharge | passive | chance to absorb 30% damage and strike back at the attacker |
| Wrath of the storm | strong (via N) | powerful lightning explosion |

---

## 🛠️ Commands (operators only)

```
/lightningabilities give <player> molnikes <amount>
/lightningabilities reload
/lightningabilities open <player>
```

---

## ⚙️ Config

File `config/lightningabilities-common.toml` – all balance settings (mana regeneration, ability costs, damage, cooldowns). After editing, run `/lightningabilities reload`.
